name: CHORD Height (from Normal)
description: Poisson-integrates this asset's EXISTING normal map into a height map (Ubisoft LaForge CHORD, ChordNormalToHeight). Pure relief read off surface slope, not scene/camera geometry, so it has no notion of a physically-scaled Z extent the way MoGe does. Requires a normal map to already be on this asset -- run MoGe Geometry or a Marigold normals recipe first. Already 0..1 normalized by the solver, so it is written straight to the 'height' channel with no further rescale.
